newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins take a rest on West holidays.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins take a rest on West holidays.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were quoted higher on Monday but dealers said few deals were struck in thin trade due to British and U.S. market holidays.
"Nothing has happened over the whole day," Sberbank dealer Sergei Abramov said. "London and New York are closed, while Russians seem to have no interest in buying or selling today."
Another dealer said Russian banks were cautious in opening new positions after last week's announcements of bond freezes.
"One would not do anything without foreigners, as you never know for sure what will happen tomorrow when they come back after the long weekend," he said.

Vneshtorgbank, the main depositary for the bonds, said on Thursday and Friday Russia's police had frozen MinFin bonds with a face value of $10.73 million this month. The total nominal value of all MinFin bonds outstanding is $11 billion.
